title: The five lines
summary: Written notes sit on five lines; higher on the lines means higher in pitch.

steps.title: Staff
steps.body:
Written notes sit on a **staff**: five lines with four spaces between them. Each line and each space is one letter of the musical alphabet. The higher a note sits on the staff, the higher its pitch, and the further right you go on the keyboard.

**Why it matters:** Reading the staff opens up every songbook and piano part. Even a little reading helps you check a melody you are learning by ear.

steps.title: Line, space, line
steps.body: Going up the staff, notes go line, space, line, space: one white key at a time.

steps.title: Step and skip
steps.body: Notes that go line to the next space move one white key. Line to the next line skips one white key.
